attribution: Slayer spot names, task lists and monster spawn coordinates adapted from the listed Old School RuneScape Wiki articles (revisions given per spot) by Old School RuneScape Wiki contributors. This dataset is a modified, partial snapshot (map region ids computed from those coordinates, short names added) and is shared under the same CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 license.
verifiedWith: Region ids were checked against, and relocated wiki map pins translated with, the NPC spawn and transport data in github.com/mejrs/data_osrs (commit 7777c539839bc9c55f7f47fa4c1022a25af4e904, 2025-11-07; no licence stated). Only region ids derived from it are included.
matching: A kill point (x, y, plane) has region ((x >> 6) << 8) | (y >> 6), using the instance template for instances. A region listed by one spot belongs to that spot on every plane. In a region listed by several spots, a spot matches only if its plane is null or equals the point's plane, and its bounds are null or one [x1, y1, x2, y2] box (inclusive) contains the point. Plane and bounds are only used in such shared regions.
